text.p: Diagnostic/Retrieval Systems Inc said on Wednesday it acquired, through a merger with and into a subsidiary of the company, Pacific Technologies Inc, effective October 30, 1996.
The privately-held company is located in San Diego and provides software engineering and systems support to the U.S. Navy for the testing of shipboard combat systems.
Specific terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Pacific Technologies generated revenues over $1.5 million for its fiscal year ended September 30, 1996 and employed about 30 people, Diagnostic said.

For over 10 years, Pacific Technologies has developed a wide range of simulation software for the acceptance and validation testing of planned upgrades for combat systems on board the Navy's surface ships, Diagnostic said.
